key_insight: PedDx classifies pediatric posterior fossa tumors from MRI, with higher accuracy among cases retained after confidence-based abstention.
clinical_relevance: This diagnostic AI research—not drug discovery—may inform future imaging-based assessment, but does not establish readiness for clinical use.
method: Segmentation-free analysis of T2-weighted MRI using pretrained 3DINO representations.
Agentic workflow producing predictions and structured quality-control reports.
evidence_signal: Evaluation included 492 discovery, 114 replication, 129 external-validation and 40 independently tested cases; accuracy was 79.8%, 81.4% and 92.5% in the three test cohorts, rising to 90.5%, 88.7% and 97.3% among non-abstained cases.
watch_item: Out-of-distribution testing revealed confidently incorrect predictions, while imaging perturbations exposed acquisition and alignment vulnerabilities.
paper_title: PedDx: An End-to-End Deep Learning Framework for Pediatric Posterior Fossa Tumor Diagnosis with Agentic AI-Enabled Independent External Evaluation
